name: Whirlwind Smash (Combat, Heritage)
body:
With a flailing swing, you deliver a terrifying sweep of your weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Giant subtype, size Large or larger.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you can make a melee attack with a weapon you’re holding against a number of adjacent creatures within your reach equal to your Strength modifier. You make a separate attack roll against each target, and use your highest base attack bonus for each attack. You can only attack any one creature a single time each round when using this feat.
